# Gas Bottling Plant

> This industrial facility in the United Arab Emirates is a gas bottling and distribution plant, where bulk liquefied petroleum gas is received, stored and decanted into cylinders for onward supply. Plants of this kind bring together a filling hall and cylinder carousel, bulk storage vessels, a cylinder yard and loading bays for distribution vehicles. Dedicated fire protection, gas detection and safety systems govern the layout throughout.

## Project Overview

- Category: Infrastructure & Utilities
- Location: Jebel Ali, Dubai, UAE
- Status: Completed

## MENASCO Scope

This project comprised a gas bottling and distribution plant in the UAE, an industrial facility for filling and dispatching gas cylinders. It was delivered with Abdulhadi Contracting as main contractor and Khatib & Alami as consultant. MENASCO executed the MEP works for the plant, providing its mechanical, electrical and plumbing services.
